messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: embedding-service-prod — sudden increase in mean cosine distance for top-k retrieval (alert threshold tripped). Pager -> Micah, severity=P2. Link: https://grafana.example.com/d/embeds/production
Micah: On it. seeing alerts in the channel. Thanks for the ping. Priya, can you pull the last model promotion ID and perf diffs?
Priya: digging. initial correlate looks like model variant `embedder-v2-2026-07-03` promoted ~2h ago. Canary QPS low but embedding drift on the 99th percentile. grabbing logs + offline eval now.
Jamal: tagging infra — any recent infra changes? autoscaler/instance type?
Priya: infra unchanged. CPU/GPU perf normal. The vector distance shift aligns with the promotion window. Running a quick retrieval test against our holdout and seeing MAP drop ~7%.
Micah: 7% MAP drop is customer-impacting. We should consider stop-gap: pin traffic back to previous variant or rollback. What's the promotion hash?
Priya: promo hash `a3f9b2c`. Previous stable was `b7d1c4a` (embedder-v1.9.8). Rolling back should be quick via the routing control plane.
Loretta: if we rollback, I'll draft a short customer note. Need ETA for mitigation and whether customers need to take action.
Alex: product note — which customers saw increased error? Any enterprise queries failing?
Priya: no runtime errors, just degraded ranking quality. Affected top-k retrieval scoring only. I'm seeing increased QA flags from three pilot customers and internal eval alerts.
Jamal: Micah, do you want SRE to initiate rollback or do you want an observational pin (route 90% to stable, 10% to canary) while we confirm?
Micah: do full rollback to be safe. We can redeploy canary after root cause. Prioritize customer experience.
Priya: executing rollback now. Command: ```
# rollback to embedder-v1.9.8
redwood route update embeddings-prod --model=b7d1c4a --weight=1.0
```
deploy-bot: Received rollback command from Priya. Initiating route update. Job id: job-7782. ETA ~2m.
deploy-bot: Route update complete. embeddings-prod -> b7d1c4a (100%). No errors.
Priya: quick synthetic checks passing. MAP back within baseline ±0.5%. Latency unchanged.
Micah: good. Jamal, can you mark the incident as mitigated and run through oncall handoff notes? Add timeline.
Jamal: will do. Drafting handoff: "Mitigated: rolled back embeddings to v1.9.8 at 2239998952. Root cause likely vectorization change in v2 code path; ML team investigating. Follow-up action: hotfix branch to revert change + deeper eval on retrain recipe."
Loretta: Customer-facing draft: "We detected a degradation in retrieval quality after a recent model update and have reverted to the prior model to restore expected results. No action needed on your side. We'll follow up with details once we complete the investigation." Thoughts?
Alex: concise and good. Add ETA for follow-up: "We'll share a technical postmortem within 72 hours."
Loretta: added. Status page draft for ops.status.redwood.com: "Resolved: embeddings service degraded after model update and was reverted at 2239998952. Customers may have observed lower-quality results between 2239998200–2239998952. No action required. Detailed root cause and next steps coming soon."
Micah: looks fine. Priya, open an investigation ticket and add all eval artifacts. Tag SRE and ML research.
Priya: ticket created: INF-2026-378. Attached perf diffs, eval notebooks, and the canary inputs that triggered the regressions.
Jamal: oncall handoff entry: "Mitigated. Monitor for related alerts for 4 hours. If MAP deviates >3% again, escalate to paging."
Micah: I'll do a quick post-rollback verification across a couple of customer routes.
Micah: quick update — internal regressions cleared, pilot customers confirm improvement. Sending customer note in 5.
Loretta: sending message now to affected pilots: "We've reverted a model update that caused reduced retrieval quality. No action required. Expect a follow-up with technical details within 72 hours. — Redwood Support" :email:
Loretta: posted to the support queue and emailed the three pilot contacts.
Micah: closing the live incident thread. Leaving ticket OPEN for investigation. Attachments: grafana link, job-7782 logs, eval notebook. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Incident thread closed by Micah. Archived job-7782 logs at https://storage.example.com/jobs/job-7782/logs
incident-bot: NOTE: please file a 72h postmortem doc and assign owners (ML: Priya, SRE: Jamal, Customer comms: Loretta).
